failed_jobs.name: Tests / Hosting.Azure / Hosting.Azure (ubuntu-latest)
failed_jobs.reason: AzureSqlPrincipalReconciliationTests fail because SqlServerContainerFixture cannot bind Docker port 1433 (address already in use) on a shared CI runner. This is an environmental Docker networking conflict, not related to the PR's VS Code extension changes.
